rationale: Matches this issue's own Out-of-scope line (harness_events schema DDL belongs to ENH-3406); ENH-3406 is still open (not landed), so widening scope here would mean two issues concurrently modifying the same table; the timeout half is already resolvable today via the existing timed_out column.
rule: Fail closed on the runner-error signal gap: --retry-of refuses admission when the superseded attempt's timed_out column is falsy, even if exit_code==2. The runner-error half of the ambiguity stays inadmissible until a future issue adds a persisted error signal to harness_events.
alternatives_rejected: Widen this issue's scope to add a persisted error signal to harness_events (schema DDL), admitting runner-error retries too — rejected: contradicts explicit Scope Boundaries, reopens ENH-3406's still-open territory, adds schema/migration risk for a Very Large issue.
